notes: UNIT_TESTS_SELECTED is deliberately the SAME command as UNIT_TESTS — the documented
'degrade to running more, never to running less' fallback. pytest-picked does not work:
`--picked` takes an optional {only,first} choice, so `--picked tests/unit` binds the path
to it and pytest exits 4 on every run; with correct syntax it exits 5 on a clean tree.
Both measured. Do not reintroduce it without running it first.
ruff format reaches Python fences inside Markdown, so a real project needs
[tool.ruff] extend-exclude = ['.claude/'] or the gate covers ~40 plugin-owned files.
BUILD is uv build: without a full-only stage `ci.sh full` refuses, and for a Python library the build IS the release artifact.
